Emulator directory exists but empty? Actually `ls /opt/android-sdk/emulator` returned nothing, then exit code 2 from `ls ~/.android/avd`. So emulator package not installed, no AVD. Guide requires emulator & virtual device. But that's environment limitation.

Let me confirm analyze 0 errors, run a build verification maybe. Let's check the flavor configs and verify APK with aapt/apkanalyzer for package name and flavor.

Also verify `flutter build` works — but rebuilding is expensive and could be considered "building missing artifacts"? The APK already exists; rebuilding isn't needed. Instead, verify the existing APK is a valid, installable app.

Let me use apkanalyzer to get package, version, and check it's debug signed.

action.command: cd /workspace; export PATH=/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH; export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64; export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk; APK=build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-ni-debug.apk; echo "=== apkanalyzer manifest ==="; timeout 180 /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/apkanalyzer manifest print $APK 2>&1 | head -40; echo "=== apk summary ==="; timeout 180 /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/apkanalyzer apk summary $APK 2>&1
